limitations: Syntax candidates, not an executed EF model or complete dynamic call graph
DbSet and Entity<T> declarations seed the model; convention-discovered/inherited/owned types still require actual provider model enumeration
Writer call names may refer to helpers; resolve target and automatic/interactive execution manually, including raw driver factories and indirect writers
No entity/property/writer classification or ID grammar accepted; B2-B4 remain unproven
